meta.title: 彻底理解做视频！记住这个词！「尼康ZR」
meta.title_en: Understand Video Creation: Remember This One Word! | Nikon ZR

scenes.title_en: One Word to Start Video Creation
scenes.context: 博主提出「联系」这个词，作为五分钟内从浅到深理解视频创作的钥匙。
sentences: 有一个词可以在接下来五分钟里让你从浅到深理解视频创作。
One word will take you from shallow to deep understanding of video creation in the next five minutes.
from shallow to deep（从浅到深）
这个词就是——联系。
That word is connection.
connection（联系）
具体点，画面之间的联系。
More precisely, the connections between shots.
connections between shots（画面之间的联系）
scenes.speak: One word will take you from shallow to deep understanding of video creation in the next five minutes. That word is connection. More precisely, the connections between shots.

scenes.context: 把视线引向同一个位置，画面就有舒适的观感；视觉焦点乱跳则让人眼花。
sentences: 比如视觉焦点的联系。
Take visual focus connections, for example.
visual focus（视觉焦点）
只要都把视线引向同一个地方，这个画面就有舒适的观感。
As long as every shot pulls your eye to the same spot, the sequence feels comfortable.
comfortable feel（舒适的观感）
你的视觉焦点就是你第一眼注意的位置，它一直在发生变化。
Your visual focus is where you look first, and it keeps shifting.
first glance（第一眼）
scenes.speak: Take visual focus connections, for example. As long as every shot pulls your eye to the same spot, the sequence feels comfortable. Your visual focus is where you look first, and it keeps shifting.

scenes.context: 换人、换场景、换衣服这些Vlog常见玩法，底层都是动势的联系。
sentences: 还有动势，或者说动作的联系。
There's also motion, or action connections.
action connection（动作联系）
换人、换场景、换衣服，底层原理都是动势的联系。
Changing people, scenes, or outfits all rely on motion connections underneath.
underlying principle（底层原理）
这是你们最熟悉、最实用的Vlog转场玩法。
This is the most familiar, practical Vlog transition trick you know.
practical transition（实用转场）
scenes.speak: There's also motion, or action connections. Changing people, scenes, or outfits all rely on motion connections underneath. This is the most familiar, practical Vlog transition trick you know.

scenes.context: 同色、同色调、同形状都能成为画面之间的连接点。
sentences: 还可以是颜色：不同的画面都包含相同的颜色。
It can also be color: different shots all contain the same color.
same color（相同颜色）
也可以让整段画面统一在同一个色调里。
Or keep the whole segment in one color tone.
color tone（色调）
形状也有联系。
Shapes connect too.
shape（形状）
scenes.speak: It can also be color: different shots all contain the same color. Or keep the whole segment in one color tone. Shapes connect too.

scenes.context: 进阶到声音：尾音重叠、音效关联、音乐画面配合、歌词台词呼应。
sentences: 进阶到声音的联系。
Now we advance to sound connections.
sound connection（声音联系）
除了尾音重叠之外，还可以让两个画面在音效上产生微妙的关联。
Beyond overlapping endings, two shots can connect subtly through sound effects.
subtle link（微妙关联）
音乐和画面之间的联系也很重要，像慢动作配现在的音乐就配合得很舒适。
Music and image connect too—slow motion against this track feels just right.
slow motion（慢动作）
歌词和台词，也可以有声音上的联系。
Lyrics and dialogue can connect through sound as well.
lyrics and dialogue（歌词与台词）
scenes.speak: Now we advance to sound connections. Beyond overlapping endings, two shots can connect subtly through sound effects. Music and image connect too—slow motion against this track feels just right. Lyrics and dialogue can connect through sound as well.

scenes.context: 进入思路的世界：画面之间的联系能否产生新的表达，关键看是否服务故事。
sentences: 进入思路的世界，也就是画面之间的联系能不能产生新的表达。
Enter the world of ideas: can shot connections create new meaning?
new expression（新的表达）
比如前一个画面是一棵树，后面如果是张纸，可能就产生不了什么联想。
A tree followed by paper may spark nothing.
no association（没有联想）
但后面如果变成一把斧头，你的脑中就会有一些词汇产生。
But if it's an axe next, words start forming in your head.
trigger words（触发词汇）
关键还是看它是否服务你的故事。
What matters is whether it serves your story.
serve the story（服务故事）
scenes.speak: Enter the world of ideas: can shot connections create new meaning? A tree followed by paper may spark nothing. But if it's an axe next, words start forming in your head. What matters is whether it serves your story.

scenes.context: 所有公式都可以被打破：联系不需要严丝合缝，也可以是若有若无的。
sentences: 现在你要做的，就是把它彻底撕碎，狠狠扔进垃圾桶里。
Now your job is to tear it all up and toss it in the trash.
tear it up（撕碎）
联系，从来都不需要严丝合缝。
Connection never needs to be seamless.
seamless（严丝合缝）
也可以是一座铺满的铸铁人像，若有若无的联系最迷人。
Or a cast-iron figure—the faintest connections are the most charming.
barely-there connection（若有若无的联系）
scenes.speak: Now your job is to tear it all up and toss it in the trash. Connection never needs to be seamless. Or a cast-iron figure—the faintest connections are the most charming.

scenes.context: 带着相机出门拍下所见，此刻的片段可能五年后才找到属于它的故事。
sentences: 所以出门吧，拿着这台裸机只有540克的相机出门吧。
So go out—with this camera that weighs only 540 grams.
540 grams（540克）
此刻拍到的片段，可能五年之后才找到和它完美联系的故事。
Today's clips may find their perfect story five years later.
perfect story（完美故事）
剩下90%的创作只能靠你自己，那是你与世界的联系。
The other 90% of creation is on you—that's your connection with the world.
your connection with the world（你与世界的联系）
scenes.speak: So go out—with this camera that weighs only 540 grams. Today's clips may find their perfect story five years later. The other 90% of creation is on you—that's your connection with the world.

practice: Connections between shots make sequences feel comfortable.
Pulling the eye to one spot creates a comfortable feel.
Changing people, scenes, or outfits all rely on motion links.
Sound effects and music can subtly bridge two shots.
A tree followed by an axe triggers words in your mind.
pitfalls: Expressive connections can create new meaning.
Shots connect through focus, motion, color, and sound.
Connections never need to be seamless.
Tear them up once you understand the idea.
Today's clips may find their story years later.
shifts: 用 connection（联系）、visual focus（视觉焦点）、action link（动作联系）
用 sound bridge（声音桥梁）、expressive link（表达联系）、seamless（严丝合缝）
用 1+1>2（一加一大于二）、serve the story（服务故事）、your link with the world（与世界的联系）
